id.description: The UiD of the association model

isVerified.description: Annotates whether the association has been validated

ownershipPercentage.description:
The percentage amount of the target entity owned by the source entity
(optional)

properties.description: A list of custom properties that describe the association

AssociationDto.description: The metadata of an association between two entities

data.description: The metadata of an association between two entities
The metadata of an association between two entities

category.description: List of requirement category e.g. ["Basic Details", "Enrich Details"]

version.description:
Current version of the Draft where you want to apply your changes. This parameter is required 
to guarantee consistency and conflicts detection. If it is not provided, it will save new changes
on top of latest without conflicts checking

EntityDraftDto.description: Request DTO to update entity draft

dataSources.description: Additional data sources used for evaluation

triggerValidation.description: If true, it will trigger validation of the entity draft

ExistingAssociatedEntityCommentsDto.description: Comment for Existing Associated Entity in the System

data.description: Comment for Existing Associated Entity in the System

version.description: Version of outreach data after update

hasValidationErrors.description: Flag indicating occurrence of validation errors for invalid properties

OutreachDataCommandResponseDto.description: Response DTO representing updated outreach data

data.description: Response DTO representing updated outreach data

comment.description: Optional free-text comment supplied by the portal user explaining why removal is requested.

version.description:
Version of the related party the removal request was raised against. Mandatory.
A mismatch against the stored version is reported as a conflict rather than overwriting
changes made since the caller last read the related party.

associationIds.description: Optional list of association IDs to mark for deletion as part of this removal request.

RequestRelatedDataRemovalDto.description: Request body for requesting soft-deletion (removal) of a related party.
